articles.summary: LandBridge Company LLC (NYSE: LB; NYSE TX: LB) ("LandBridge") today announced that it will release its financial results for the third quarter of 2026 after market close on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. LandBridge will host a webcast and conference call to discuss its results on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 10 a.m. Central Time / 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Webcast Instructions: To listen to the live webcast, please visit the Events and Presentations section of the LandBridge Investor Relations website. Please visit the site at least 10-15 minutes prior to the scheduled start time to register and install any necessary audio software. The webcast will be archived on the site for those unable to listen in real-time. Conference Call Instructions: To access the live conference call, participants must pre-register online at https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/108208093?pwd=Gl2YMlcj to receive unique dial-in information. Pre-registration may be completed at any time up to the call start time.
articles.title: LandBridge Schedules Third Quarter Earnings Release and Conference Call

articles.summary: LandBridge Corporation (NYSE: LB; NYSE Texas: LB) (“LandBridge” or the “Company”) today announced that it has completed its previously announced conversion and redomestication from a Delaware limited liability company with the name of LandBridge Company LLC to a Texas corporation with the name of LandBridge Corporation (the “Conversion and Redomestication”). The Conversion and Redomestication was approved by the Company’s Board of Directors (the “Board”) upon the recommendation of a special committee of independent directors and the holder of a majority of shares representing limited liability company interests in the Company. As a result of the Conversion and Redomestication, LandBridge expects to be eligible for potential future inclusion in various stock indices, including key SP, Russell and CRSP indices. articles.title: LandBridge Announces Completion of Conversion and Redomestication in Texas
